open_findings.root_cause_hypothesis_not_db_confirmed: Traced two candidate layers, not fully confirmed without direct Postgres access (blocked in this sandbox): (1) src/lib/platform/zerodte-service.ts:494-499 `boardClosedReason` fallback is `engineExitCategory ?? "time_stop"` -- UNCONDITIONAL, not gated on whether nowEtMinutes is actually near/past PLAN_RULES.time_stop_et_minutes (15:50 ET). This is a real logic defect independent of any timing race: ANY row whose engineExitCategory cannot be derived (missing/stale entry_context.exit, unmapped reason) gets mislabeled "time_stop" specifically, regardless of actual time of day -- CMPS closed at ~12:02 ET, nowhere near the real time-stop threshold, yet got that exact label. So the SAME request/tick that closes a play via the exit engine would always render that build with a stale entry_context (no .exit) -- self-correcting only once a LATER buildZeroDteBoardPayload does a fresh readZeroDteLedgerChecked() DB read that picks up the by-then-persisted stamp. Does not fully explain why THIS instance took ~20 minutes across 3 distinct polls when the warm cron runs ~every 5 min -- that gap is the part still needing DB-side confirmation (e.g. whether readZeroDteLedgerChecked is itself served from a cache layer this sandbox cannot inspect, or whether some other condition kept re-selecting the stale row).
